per_claim.no_dataset_reason: I could not verify any public dataset of 3D red blood cell surface reconstructions (holotomography, confocal or scanning-probe) with matched isotonic and hypotonic conditions. Searches of Zenodo, figshare and Dryad found none. The closest source with isotonic and hypotonic RBC tomography is the PLoS ONE paper 10.1371/journal.pone.0262106. Its data availability statement says the datasets are not publicly available because of participant consent, and the only downloads are figure files. The arXiv papers 2409.20013 and 1404.2968 have no deposited data that I found. I will not name a dataset or identifier I could not verify.
